landing.subtitle: Paste a playlist. Extract a masterclass. SKILLER uses hyper-intelligent processing to synthesize hours of video into actionable, structured knowledge.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Surgical precision from raw pixels to structured syntax.
landing.feature1Desc:
Raw Feed
High-bandwidth assimilation of audio, visual data, and metadata from source playlists.
landing.feature2Desc:
Neural Extraction
LLM-driven semantic analysis identifies core concepts, filtering redundant noise.
landing.feature3Desc:
SKILL.md
Compilation into a pristine, version-controlled markdown blueprint ready for execution.
landing.deepDiveDesc: Standard tools just dump text. SKILLER builds a conceptual graph of the video, mapping dependencies, extracting code blocks, and highlighting pivotal moments with surgical accuracy.
landing.deepDiveFeature1:
Auto-Chapter Generation
Intelligent segmentation based on topic shifts, not just time.
landing.deepDiveFeature2:
Syntax Extraction
Automatically identifies and formats code blocks shown on screen.

slides.title: PASTE THE PLAYLIST
slides.description: Skiller reads the whole playlist through the YouTube Data API: title, description, ordering and metadata for every video. No downloads, no setup.

slides.title: EVERY VIDEO BECOMES A CARD
slides.description: Each transcript runs through a pipeline that returns validated JSON: key concepts, a dense summary, and the code blocks shown on screen.

slides.title: A SKILL, NOT A SUMMARY
slides.description: The cards are synthesized into one coherent document, with mapped dependencies and a learning order — instead of a pile of disconnected summaries.

slides.title: SKILL.md
slides.description: Markdown ready to commit to your repo and be read by your coding assistant. No rework, no copy and paste.
